title: Replacing One Thing with Another: sino, en vez de, en lugar de
goal: Replace one idea with another using sino, en vez de and en lugar de.
grammar: sino, en vez de, en lugar de

items: I can use *sino* and *sino que* after a negative to replace an idea.
I can use *en vez de* and *en lugar de* with a noun or an infinitive.
I can tell when to use *sino* and when to use *en vez de*.
